$comment: Who signs a document, and what a defined term in its clause bodies is allowed to call them — one table, read by both the renderer (sigParties in draft-ai-engine.html) and templates/tools/terminology.mjs. Before this file existed the two lived as separate hardcoded copies of the same fact, and they drifted: the Service Agreement's clause bodies called the other side 'Client' throughout while the signature block, built from taxonomy.contractRoles, signed them as 'Customer' — a real defect, caught by eye rather than by any check, fixed 2026-08-20. This file exists so that class of drift cannot happen silently again. formation (taxonomy.entities.*.ownerSingular) and commercial/agreements (taxonomy.contractRoles) are already single-sourced from the shared taxonomy and are not duplicated here. hiring's second signer is composed at render time from the engagement answer and the role title rather than a fixed caption, and no hiring clause body quotes a role term, so there is nothing here to drift and nothing to check.
